clip_texts: SC-12 Emergency vehicle approaching with siren and lights
An emergency vehicle approaches from behind, ahead or across a junction while the vehicle drives or waits

One concrete scenario (seeded sample of the logical
scenario)
ODD-20 Ego speed: 34.1 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h)
ODD-18 Special vehicles: emergency-vehicle
ODD-17 Traffic density: free-flow
ODD-04 Junctions: t-junction

Speed of the emergency vehicle: Bound stated by FSR-06.01, not yet
fixed; the motion drawn is choreography

Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033);
choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
Safety goals at stake

SG-06 (ASIL D): Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or
crosswalk against right of way
Pass criterion

The vehicle detects the emergency vehicle, pulls to the side when
safe or stops, and lets it pass; when it cannot yield it reaches a
minimal risk condition (FSR-06.01, FSR-06.03, FSR-07.05,
FSR-02.02, FM-15, TR-14, AC-02)
Autoware's planned path (EL-01 Autoware computer, rated QM)
Safety monitor's envelope (EL-02, ASIL D); length not computed: the vehicle is not chosen yet (DQ-008)
Meant to do: pulls aside and lets it pass
Dashed green: the path the pass criterion asks of the vehicle; green ring: where it is judged
Where the hazard lies: Emergency vehicle approaching with siren and lights
Amber, ringed: the road user the scenario is about
